resolution: Every native archive message; no resampling
scope: Best bid/ask after applying each full-depth source update
caveats: Not a 10ms historical level-1 feed. Live 10ms data cannot be backfilled.
Millisecond timestamp precision does not mean millisecond observations.
Every archive event is retained, even when the best quote is unchanged.
Empty/one-sided/crossed/locked books are flagged, not filled or removed.
Archives can overlap day boundaries. Do not concatenate blindly.
An archive listing with no missing dates does not prove no feed gaps.
Source timestamps and repeated events are not altered or deduplicated.
RPI orders are excluded by the upstream Bybit feed.
